::: lead-text
I am a second-year PhD student in Statistics at [Ghent University](https://www.ugent.be/en) under the supervision of Prof. Dr. [Stijn Vansteelandt](https://users.ugent.be/~svsteela/). My research lies at the intersection of **causal inference** and **debiased machine learning**. If you want to get in touch, please don't hesitate to contact me.
:::
